name: Reset→Move -Mobius loop-
source:
Those days when we laughed and cried over the smallest things, when school felt like the entire world.
What I wanted to take back was———

Together with the refreshing upperclassman Chiba Haruma and the whimsical underclassman Wakatsuki Rinta,
this is a theater-style otome game where you relive the days of high school youth.
Note: Both of them are quite jealous, so there’s a bit of a dark twist.
translation:
那些日子，我们为最小的事情欢笑和哭泣，那时学校就像整个世界。
我想要拿回来的是——

与清爽的高年级学生千叶春马和异想天开的低年级学生若槻凛太一起，
这是一款剧场风格的乙女游戏，让你重温高中时代的青春时光。
注：两人都很嫉妒，所以有一点黑暗的转折。
